items.title: Mask My File — Hide private details to share | iOS App

A project is a self-contained set of books: its own transactions, its own currency and its own bottom line. MoneyTag tallies the income, takes off the expenses and shows the net result for that project alone. Does MoneyTag convert between currencies? Each project has its own base currency. On the Home screen, choose the input currency directly. MoneyTag uses public exchange rates refreshed about every 6 hours, or you can set a manual rate and later reset to automatic. Tag any income or expense, and the Tags screen totals that same tag across all of your projects at once — income, expenses and the net for the tag. Cross-project tag analysis is part of Lifetime Pro.
